title: Missed cross-sell: parents mentioned twice
description: Sales call. The customer twice mentions elderly parents with medical needs; the agent sells only an individual plan. Disclosures are done correctly, so no compliance nudge is expected.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Priya from Nivaran Health Insurance. This call is being recorded for quality purposes. Am I speaking with Mr. Arjun?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, this is Arjun. I filled a form on your website yesterday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Arjun. Who would you like to cover under the health plan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Just me for now. I'm thirty two and I work in Bengaluru.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Do you have any existing health conditions?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, nothing. But my parents are both above sixty and my father had a knee surgery last year, so I keep worrying about their medical bills too.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. For you, our Essential plan with five lakh cover would be a good fit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. And what about the waiting period?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after thirty six months, and there is a thirty day initial waiting period, except for accidents.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hmm, okay. Honestly my mother's hospital visits are getting more frequent, that's the bigger worry for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. So for yourself, the indicative premium is about five thousand six hundred rupees a year.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That sounds reasonable. How do I go ahead with it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll email you the proposal form link and you can complete it today.
